title: Total Hamming Distance
description: Given an integer array `nums` of non-negative integers, return the sum of the Hamming distances between all unordered pairs of elements `(nums[i], nums[j])` with `0 <= i < j < nums.length`.
constraints: The answer is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit signed integer.
hints: Bit positions are independent, so evaluate the contribution of each of the 31 bit positions separately.
If `ones` numbers have bit `b` set and `n - ones` have bit `b` clear, bit `b` contributes `ones * (n - ones)` to the total.

examples.explanation: Pairs are (4,14)=2, (4,2)=2, and (14,2)=2, giving a total of 6.
Pairs are (4,14)=2, (4,4)=0, and (14,4)=2, giving a total of 4.
A single-element array has no unordered pairs, so the total is 0.
